sources.claim: UnshieldedWalletState.availableCoins/pendingCoins call getAvailableCoins/getPendingCoins; progress returns underlying state.progress.
Coin getters return availableUtxos/pendingUtxos arrays; balance calculation destructures {utxo} and reads utxo.type/utxo.value.

Wire fields owner/tokenType/value/intentHash/outputIndex become utxo.owner/type/value/intentHash/outputNo; metadata is separate ctime Date and registeredForDustGeneration boolean; schema receives created/spent arrays.

UtxoWithMeta wrapper; identity key intentHash#outputNo; locally spending moves wrapper available->pending; successful sync removes spent from both and adds created to available; toArrays returns wrappers unchanged.
Actual public subscription is address/transactionId scoped; decoder feeds created/spent wrappers to CoreWallet; applies transaction.id as appliedId and progress event highestTransactionId.
Strict completeness is connected with zero appliedId/highestTransactionId gap; values originate as bigint.
Actual coin balancer explicitly maps available wrappers to utxo and compares intentHash plus outputNo; it does not compare physical segment as wallet identity.
Public wire value string decodes through BigInt(value); wallet domain value is bigint, not number or string.
Both created/spent subscription records request owner, tokenType,value,outputIndex,intentHash,ctime,registration; progress requests highestTransactionId.

Current reviewed decoder uses intent.intentHash(0) for guaranteed outputs, physical segment for fallible outputs, and offer array index as offerIndex; existing input origins stay input.intentHash/outputNo.
Current guard retains strict child/DUST gates but compares flat c.intentHash/c.outputNo for old unshielded inputs; this does not inspect actual coin.utxo wrappers.

proposedStrictPredicate.basis: Source-grounded proposed continuation gate; unperformed on actual wallet
preconditions: Canonical finalized initialize/full financial comparison and exact unchanged initialized-state gates must pass first. This mapping does not establish them.

Retain strict connected and isStrictlyComplete()===true on shielded/unshielded/dust progress. Additionally require unshielded appliedId/highestTransactionId bigint, equal, and >=35n for this retained indexer instance; transaction35 is an offset guard, not a cryptographic identity substitute.

Validate arrays and every UtxoWithMeta record used by the gate: coin.utxo object with intentHash/owner/type 64lowercasehex strings, outputNo safe nonnegative integer, value positive bigint; malformed or flat-only entries fail rather than normalize.
identityCheck: Identify rows by coin.utxo.intentHash===expected.intentHash AND coin.utxo.outputNo===0, not by amount or physical segment.
Require exactly one available row for this origin/index and zero pending rows for this origin/index.
Require that available row.utxo.owner/type equal the exact borrower/color and row.utxo.value===20000000000n. Reject duplicate-origin or conflicting-owner/color/value entries.
Do not require meta.registeredForDustGeneration===true for the minted USD_TEST_ASSET. That metadata flag is not the unshielded coin identity or the separate DUST balance requirement.

For every original deploy AND initialize spent unshielded origin/index, require absence from BOTH availableCoins and pendingCoins using c.utxo fields. Keep these checks separate from the minted-output presence predicate.

Retain no pendingDust, absent historical deploy+initialize DUST oldNullifiers via actual DustLocalState.findUtxoByNullifier, available registered DUST and balance at fresh canonical indexed time >= entire new cap. Retain per-balance/submission native-time guards.
proposedStrictPredicate.publicResult: Only a closed predicate status/identity digest should be emitted; never serialize wallet arrays/metadata/state.
proposedStrictPredicate.notGuaranteed: Availability in a synchronized observed wallet is eligibility for its balancer, not an unconditional guarantee of future consumption or ledger acceptance.

findings.detail: Existing assertRecoveryWallet line55 reads c.intentHash/c.outputNo although actual availableCoins/pendingCoins contain c.utxo. Real wrapped spent inputs can therefore be missed. A continuation must repair this predicate and test real wrapper shape; this receipt edits no frozen source and does not retroactively claim old wallet evidence.
findings.historicalScope: Original deployment binding has zero spentUnshieldedInputs (recover-deployment.test.mjs line16); therefore this source defect does not establish a historical missed unshielded spend. It remains a latent guard defect for any nonempty historic input list and must be corrected before applying it to continuation.

findings.detail: Native guaranteed physical21861 offerIndex0 maps directly to wrapped utxo at origin4d343d... outputNo0. Do not substitute intentHash(21861), output_index24(rowid), transactionid35 or physicalsegment21861 for outputNo0.

recommendedTests: Actual public wire record decoded by installed SyncSchema produces wrapper with bigint20e9 and outputNo0; test wrapper, not a fabricated flat object.
Reject minted output missing, onlypending, duplicateorigin, wrongowner/color/value, incorrect nonzero-segment origin, or swapped rowid/transactionid/outputNo.
Wrapped historicalspentinput in either available/pending must fail; flat/malformed shape must fail closed.
Keep disconnected/gapped progress, pendingDUST, historicalspentDUST presence and insufficient fullcap tests; no live wallet required for these fixtures.
limitations: No actual current availableCoins/pendingCoins array was read; present spendability remains unobserved. Historical spending_transaction_id null is only the stopped capture.
No live canonical finality/current UTXO query was performed. Concurrent later spending can invalidate observations; recheck through existing freshness and transaction guards.
